module: Determines whether the delivery tutorials (parcels, vehicles, materials) are still active and provides the tutorial task lists for the career progress page. A tutorial is active as long as the XP of the corresponding branch (logistics-delivery, logistics-vehicleDelivery, logistics-materials) is 0; the result is cached and invalidated when this XP changes, which also unlocks an achievement.
notes: The cache (tutorialStatusCache) is cleared in onPlayerAttributesChanged; the achievements DELIVERY_TUTORIAL_COMPLETED, VEHICLE_DELIVERY_COMPLETED and MATERIALS_DELIVERY_COMPLETED are unlocked on each change of the corresponding attribute, not only the first time.

currentVehicleHasDryBulkContainer and currentVehicleHasTutorialMaterials always return false: the "load materials" step of the materials tutorial is therefore never checked before the end of the tutorial.
tutorialVehicleTakenOutOfFacility tests any vehicle task with isTutorialVehicle, not only that of the current vehicle.
currentOrNearbyVehicleHasContainer considers a container attached within 20 m of the player (or the current vehicle).
getTutorialInfo only fills in 'parcel' and 'vehicle'; the 'materials-introduction' tutorial exists in onCareerProgressPageGetTasklistData but is not included.
The titles 'Delivery Introduction', 'Vehicle Delivery Introduction' and 'Materials Introduction' are in English, not translated.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the delivery extensions used.

isCargoDeliveryTutorialActive.desc: True as long as the logistics-delivery XP is 0 (result cached).

isVehicleDeliveryTutorialActive.desc: True as long as the logistics-vehicleDelivery XP is 0 (cached).

isMaterialsDeliveryTutorialActive.desc: True as long as the logistics-materials XP is 0 (cached).

onPlayerAttributesChanged.desc: Hook called when player attributes change: invalidates the cache of the tutorial concerned and unlocks the associated achievement.

getTutorialInfo.desc: Returns the state of the parcel and vehicle tutorials: unlocked, isActive and the task list, for the UI.

onCareerProgressPageGetTasklistData.desc: Progress page hook: fills tasklistData.headerLabel and tasklistData.tasks ({label, description, done}) for 'delivery-introduction' (install a container, load a tutorial parcel, deliver), 'vehicle-delivery-introduction' (pick up the vehicle, deliver) or 'materials-introduction'. If the tutorial is finished, a single "finished" task is returned.
